general_information.Description: This course instructs students how to apply translation techniques in dealing with interlingual translation of different types of texts including administrative forms and documents (degrees, certificate, contracts..); business forms and documents (business transaction agreement, financial statements); technical news and documents; socio-cultural news and documents. After taking this course, students should be able to: - Demonstrate a clear understanding of different types and formats of texts - Demonstrate a clear understanding terms used the administrative documents, technical, economic, scientific, socio-cultural news and documents... - Translate the mentioned kinds of news and documents from Vietnamese into English and vice-versa. - Use Gen-AI tools to enhance translation quality and facilitate translation processes
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination '- Actively participate in class activities '- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class '- Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes '- Read the theory in advance '- Use Gen-AI tools in an appropriate and ethical manner

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: enhance student’s linguistic competence in translating administrative documents, and translate those documents with precision, accuracy and consistency
enhance student’s linguistic competence in translating buisness forms and financial documents , and and translate those documents with precision, accuracy and consistency
enhance student’s linguistic competence in translating technical documentation, and translate those documents with precision, accuracy and consistency
analyse and translate a complex using appropriate analytical methods and the ability to synthesise information in socio - cultural news and documents
have a professional working attitude, and have ability to work in a team
appropriately use Gen-AI tools to enhance translation quality and facilitate translation processes
